raw_response:
I look at my 4.1 mu and think — same as every year. What worked last year, I do again. My man and me, just us two, no money to waste on new ideas.

Wheat comes first, plant in October after the Double Ninth festival. I buy the seed from the shop in town — the black bag kind my neighbor Liu uses, she got good harvest three years running so I copy her. I never save my own wheat seed anymore, the shop seed grows better.

Before planting I spread compound fertilizer — the 15-15-15 three-color kind. One bag each mu, so four bags plus a little more for my 4.1 mu. Then the tractor man comes and ploughs it in, 40 yuan each mu he charges. After winter when wheat turns green in March, I spread urea — half a bag each mu, that's about 25 jin. Sometimes if I worry I put a bit more, better too much than the wheat turn yellow.

Water the wheat four times — before the ground freezes, when it greens up, when the stem joints, and when grain filling. My well still works, I pay for electricity only. When wheat is heading I watch for aphids — if I see them I spray once, pesticide from the shop, the green bottle. Sometimes I spray weed killer too before winter. Last year I got maybe 900 jin each mu, that's normal for my field.

After wheat harvest in June I don't plough — waste of time and money. The machine cuts wheat and drills maize seed right in the stubble, same day. Maize I use the hybrid seed, the 335 kind everyone plants. At sowing the machine drops some DAP with the seed — about half bag each mu. When maize is knee-high I spread urea between the rows, one bag for the whole field. I walk with a basin and throw by hand.

Maize needs less water than wheat, two times is enough unless summer very dry. Corn borer sometimes bad — I spray once when tassels coming out. Last year maize gave me about 1100 jin each mu. 

I don't change my way. Change is risky. If seed dealer tells me new thing I ask the neighbors first. Fertilizer cost is biggest worry — 150 yuan one bag compound, 120 yuan urea. For 4.1 mu I spend maybe 1500 yuan fertilizer whole year, plus seed, plus machine, plus water electricity. Not much left after selling grain, but enough for us two old people.
